An Enthralling Evening with Bombay Vikings
Get ready for a riveting experience as Neeraj Shridhar, the lead vocalist of the iconic Bombay Vikings, is set to take the stage for a live concert on the 18th of October, 2026. This unforgettable event, auspiciously titled 'BOMBAY VIKINGS Live in Concert', promises to be a night filled with soulful music, nostalgic Bollywood remixes, and engaging performances. Don't miss out on the chance to witness the magic of Hindi music in the heart of Plainsboro, NJ.
Neeraj Shridhar: A Maestro of Melodies
Neeraj Shridhar is a name synonymous with enchanting music and captivating performances. This Indian film playback singer and composer has won hearts worldwide as the lead vocalist of the pop and rock group, Bombay Vikings. Known for their popular remix hits like "Kya Soorat Hai", "Woh Chali", and "Chod Do Anchal", Shridhar's talent and charisma have made Bombay Vikings a household name in the world of music. Get ready to be bewitched by his mesmerizing voice and dynamic stage presence.
Community Middle School: The Perfect Stage for a Musical Extravaganza
The concert is set to take place at the Community Middle School, located at 95 Grovers Mill Rd in Plainsboro, NJ, United States. Known for its spacious accommodations and top-notch facilities, the venue ensures a seamless and enjoyable experience for all attendees. The location is easily accessible and surrounded by numerous attractions, including a variety of Indian restaurants to satisfy your culinary cravings before or after the concert. Ample parking space is available at the venue for a hassle-free experience.
Grab Your Tickets Today!
Book your spot today for this musical extravaganza. General admission for adults is priced at $70.00, while tickets for kids are available at $60.00. Secure your tickets now and get ready for an unforgettable night of music and entertainment with Neeraj Shridhar and the Bombay Vikings.
